BiblicalUsage: To seize or snatch away is Job's word for God taking away, when no one can hinder Him or ask what He is doing. It is the language of a power that answers to no one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job is right that God cannot be stopped or questioned, and my comfort is that the hand which seizes is the hand of a Father.
